T he Oyo State Police Command said it has arrested 10 suspects in the aftermath of a violent cult clash that occurred in Ogbomoso, Oyo State. The FPRO, Ani Iniedu, in a statement on his X account on Saturday, said large quantities of illicit drugs were also recovered from the suspects. The statement read, “Following intelligence that rival cult factions (‘Wahala N Pa’yan’ and ‘Orita Exchange Boys’) engaged in a violent street clash over the sharing of money gifts at Aaje Area, Ogbomoso North LGA. “The Area Commander led a joint team of police operatives, tactical units, and Amotekun Corps to the scene, professionally containing the crowd and arresting 10 suspects. “Searches conducted led to the recovery of 92 pieces of Ice drug, 74 pieces of Loud drug, 24 pieces of Colorado, three wraps of Scottish drug, one ice pot, two gas lighters, and an Infinix Android phone.” N50m feud rocks Oyo City Boy Movement Only 1,996 doctors serve 10 million Oyo residents, says NMA 2027: Makinde predicts nationwide victory for APM The statement added that the case is currently being investigated by the SCID in Ibadan, the Oyo State capital. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources Similarly, the Adamawa State Police Command said it has repelled an attack by Boko Haram terrorists on a police station. According to the statement, at about 1:30 am on Saturday, a large number of Boko Haram insurgents armed with sophisticated weapons advanced through Kopre Hills and attacked Kuva-Gaya Police Station in Hong LGA, setting the facility ablaze. “Combined security forces comprising Police Tactical Units, the Military, Civilian JTF, and Forest Guards promptly mobilised and successfully repelled the insurgents, pushing them back toward the hills. “Fortunately, no casualties were recorded, and no arms or ammunition were carted away during the attack. Aggressive confidence-building patrols and aerial/ground surveillance are ongoing,” the statement said.
